patch.value: The mandatory docstring gate could skip its own scan and still exit zero

isMainInvocation resolved this module's own path inside a try block that swallowed every failure and returned false. Returning false leaves main() unreached and process.exitCode at zero, so a release could pass the mandatory docstring gate having scanned nothing. The two resolutions now differ: an unresolvable argv[1] still answers false because that is the ordinary imported-by-a-test case, while an unresolvable own module path throws. A regression test asserts the throw and was mutation-checked by reverting the fix, which makes it fail.

value.author: claude
value.text: Mutation-checked in pm-slack by reverting the split resolution back to the single try block, which makes the new test fail; the identical fix and test ship here.

patch.value: A docstring gate whose own path cannot be resolved must fail the release rather than exit zero having scanned nothing.
isMainInvocation throws on self-resolution failure; a regression test asserts the throw and the suite passes.
Split the two path resolutions so only an unresolvable argv[1] answers false; an unresolvable own module path now throws.
